summary: Today's briefing presents a mixed legal and retail update driven by key judicial appointments and shifting FMCG market metrics. Primary drivers include Justice Rajesh Bindal taking over as NCLAT Chairperson and Nielsen reporting a tripling of e-commerce's FMCG market share.

bullets.text: Former Supreme Court Justice Rajesh Bindal has been appointed as the Chairperson of the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal.
The Centre cleared the appointment of CESTAT judicial member Ajay Sharma as a judge of the Bombay High Court.
E-commerce share in India's FMCG retail sales tripled over two years, according to market research firm Nielsen.
Shiprocket reported a maiden net profit of ₹60 lakh for Q2, swinging from a ₹20.29 crore loss in the previous year.
Marico expects its digital-first brand 4700BC to break even ahead of schedule within the next year.
